summary: The appellant, former Agricultural Officer at State Seed Farm, Perambra, was convicted for misappropriating auction proceeds totaling Rs.78,706/- during 1992–1994. The prosecution proved that two-thirds of auction amounts from coconuts and grains were collected but not remitted to the treasury, violating Section 13(1)(c) read with Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 and Section 409 IPC. The Trial Court convicted him; High Court upheld conviction but reduced sentence from two to one year rigorous imprisonment. The Supreme Court examined the evidence, including audit reports and attendance records, and found no reason to interfere with the findings. Issues included abuse of public office, criminal breach of trust, and sufficiency of evidence.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 13(1)(c) read with Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988
Section 409 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860
Section 477A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860
Section 19 of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988
Section 313 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction upheld with one year of rigorous imprisonment and fine.
